## [Groom & Board](https://local.yahoo.com/info-213849856-groom-board-philadelphia/)

4.5[45 reviews](https://local.yahoo.com/info-213849856-groom-board-philadelphia/)

Groom & Board is here to satisfy all of your pet's needs! We offer grooming for dogs of all sizes, as well as cats. Our groomer is skilled in breed specifics, hand scissoring and hand stripping. When it comes to nervous dogs, she is exceptionally compassionate and takes the time to make each dog feel comfortable. Your dog will, without a doubt, walk away with a beautiful cut! In addition to grooming, we also offer daycare. Our daycare is open from 7 am to 7 pm Monday-Friday. Our friendly staff is dedicated to taking excellent care of your pup while you are at work. Our daycare is open to friendly dogs of all breeds. We also ask that all potential daycare dogs come in between 7-7:30am for a behavior assessment to make sure we are a good fit for your dog. Going away on vacation or a business trip? No problem! Groom and Board also offers boarding to current daycare clients, and those who just need to board their dogs for the week, night, or longer. Our daycare clients can keep their pups in daycare throughout the day and at night they retreat to their cozy suite. We have kennels that have doggie doors in the middle which can be opened, allowing siblings to stay together during their stay. All boarding dogs are given four 15-minute walks each day, and we will stick to your feeding schedule, as well as administer all medications
